market_question: Will PSG win the 2025–26 Champions League?
reasoning: No team in modern Champions League history has a pre‑season win probability even close to 58.5%; even overwhelming favorites rarely exceed 20–25%. PSG lost Kylian Mbappé, have never won the tournament, and face a concentrated field of elite rivals. Their true title chance for 2025–26 is roughly 10%, making the market price an extreme overvaluation.
evidence_points: Even the strongest CL favourites pre‑season typically max out around 15–20% implied probability (e.g., Man City, Real Madrid).
PSG no longer have Mbappé and have never progressed past the semi‑finals in any recent season.
Multiple European champions (Real Madrid, Manchester City, Bayern, etc.) are similarly or more resourced, spreading probability broadly.
